sources.snippet: Overview Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct-abliterated is an uncensored vision-language model created by huihui-ai through abliteration of Qwen's official 7-billion-parameter vision model. Abliteration modifies the model's text processing component to remove refusal behaviors while leaving the image understanding capabilities intact.
